name: Primary
use: Use for the one record or commit in a footer.

name: Secondary
use: Use for Back or another supporting exit.
notUse: Not for committing data — use primary.

name: Text action
use: Use for Clear, Reset or Edit beside content.
notUse: Not for the footer commit — use primary.

name: Hold
use: Use for Finish farrowing, Lock or End task with deliberate confirmation.
notUse: Not for a reversible edit — use primary.

name: Tool
use: Use for labelled mid-sheet acts such as Record death or Set count.
notUse: Not for the final commit — use primary.

name: Destructive
use: Use for Delete an attachment in the real Farrowing photo dialog.
notUse: Not for ending a task — use hold with danger tone.
